newsitem.title: SPAIN: Wall Street dulls Madrid stocks at close.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street dulls Madrid stocks at close.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended at a new high on Tuesday, but off session highs after Wall Street pushed lower in the afternoon, dealers said.
The general index rose 1.06 points, 0.27 percent, to 398.49 and the Ibex added 12.37 points, 0.27 percent to 4,597.20.

One trader commented: "The market can't carry on climbing forever and Wall Street had a stab at it at the open, but afterwards the movement reversed and we also corrected from highs, in line with bonds and the peseta."
He added that the bourse will likely continue to move with the U.S. market.
Telefonica added 35 pesetas to 2,880, boosted by continual interest ahead of next year's privatisation, dealers said. Endesa, also due to be privatised further next year, added 90 pesetas to 8,280.
Electric firm Sevillana, which saw a seven million share put-through by a foreign brokerage, added 10 pesetas to 1,245 on the last day of the Endesa bid for 75 percent of the firm.
Total volume was high at 60 billion pesetas.
